name: zkUSD Dollar
oneLiner: Goal3 sunset the protocol and frontend in 2024; zkUSD is an issuer-controlled ZKsync token with no current reserve or redemption evidence.
collateral: Reserve assets, counterparties, and custody arrangements are not established by a current primary source; the deployed zkUSD token contract does not by itself prove collateralization.
pegMechanism: Verified portal code accepts owner-configured stable tokens, transfers deposits to a treasury, and mints a configured return token through a vesting flow. That code establishes an issuer-controlled deposit-and-mint path, but not 1:1 USDC redemption, current reserve coverage, or a peg-maintenance mechanism.

notices.title: Current reserve and redemption evidence unavailable
notices.message: The verified portal establishes an issuer-controlled deposit-and-mint path. It does not establish current collateral assets or coverage, 1:1 USDC redemption, custody arrangements, or a durable peg-maintenance route.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: zkUSD is an issuer-controlled portal-issued stable-token receipt rather than a borrower CDP. The canonical zkSync token deployment was created on 2023-04-04; current reserve and redemption terms remain separately unresolved.
